MUTED PALETTE: charcoal, moss green, weathered timber grey, deep indigo; the only saturated colour is warm amber lamplight and the card face. Handmade workshop details behind: hand tools on pegs, small stacked archive boxes, a shelf of odd collected treasures — a stone, a seed pod, a curl of copper wire. NOT a Pokemon, NOT a Palworld Pal, NOT any existing character, NOT a cat, NOT a raccoon. No text, no logos, no lettering. The creature is a small KEEPER with soft dark charcoal fur, very large rounded ears, enormous gentle dark eyes, and a faint warm glow at its chest like a banked ember — the light it was first seen by. It wears a canvas apron with many small pockets and tiny round spectacles pushed up on its forehead. Scholarly, careful, kind.
